metadata.title: Isoperimetric Inequalities in the $\ell_{\infty}$ cube and torus
metadata.abstract: We prove an exact isoperimetric inequality for cubes and tori under the $\ell_{\infty} metric. As a corollary, we recover the celebrated grid edge-isoperimetric inequality of Bollobás-Leader.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 建立 ℓ∞ 度量下立方体与环面的精确等周不等式，并导出网格边等周结果。
analysis.breakthrough: 统一连续立方体、环面与经典 Bollobás–Leader 网格不等式。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未列出极值形状、尺寸及测度的具体规范。 本条依据官方摘要整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立全文核查为准。
